name: itsa-quarterly-from-books
title: Fill a quarterly update from a book
description: A signed-in walk through Making Tax Digital for Income Tax's quarterly update filled from a diya-gl book: drop the book on the form, check the quarter's figures it fills, and submit the update to HMRC's test service.

steps.caption: This is a sandbox preview against HMRC's test service, not a live filing.
steps.headline: A sandbox preview

steps.caption: Sign in with the account you already use.
steps.headline: Sign in first

steps.caption: Your account keeps a whole year's filings in one place.
steps.headline: Confirm your identity

steps.caption: Bundles decide which activities you can run.
steps.headline: Open your bundles

steps.caption: Resident Pro opens the Self Assessment activities.
steps.headline: Unlock Self Assessment

steps.caption: This is the form a quarterly update is filed on.
steps.headline: The quarterly form
steps.instruction: Choose Go to file a quarterly update on the Self Assessment dashboard.

steps.caption: Type the National Insurance number.
steps.headline: Enter your NI number

steps.caption: Then the business the update is for.
steps.headline: Choose the business
steps.instruction: Enter the Business ID of the business the update is for.

steps.caption: Choose the date the quarter ends.
steps.headline: Choose the quarter end
steps.instruction: Enter the Period end date of the quarter.

steps.caption: Drop your diya-gl book on the form.
steps.headline: Drop your book
steps.instruction: Drop your diya-gl book on the box that says Drop a book here.

steps.label: Reading the book
steps.caption: The quarter's figures fill from the book.
steps.headline: The figures fill
steps.instruction: Read the status line that says the figures are filled from the book.

steps.caption: The tax year and quarter start come from the book.
steps.headline: Tax year from the book
steps.instruction: Check that the Tax year matches the book.

steps.caption: Turnover is the quarter's sales.
steps.headline: Turnover from the book
steps.instruction: Check that Turnover is the quarter's sales in your book.

steps.caption: Costs come from the book's expense accounts.
steps.headline: Costs from the book
steps.instruction: Check Cost of goods and the other expenses against your book's expense accounts.

steps.caption: Check every figure before you submit.
steps.headline: Check the figures
steps.instruction: Check every figure on the form against your records before you submit.

steps.caption: Submitting sends you to HMRC to grant access.
steps.headline: Submit the update
steps.instruction: Choose File quarterly update; the first filing sends you to HMRC to give permission.

steps.caption: Sign in to HMRC and say yes.
steps.headline: Grant HMRC access
steps.instruction: Sign in to HMRC and give permission.

steps.label: Filing the quarter
steps.caption: HMRC accepts the quarterly update.
steps.headline: HMRC accepts it
steps.instruction: Read the result to check that HMRC accepted the quarterly update.

steps.caption: The result is your record that it went through.
steps.headline: Keep the result
steps.instruction: Read the result and keep it as your record.

steps.caption: Open the tax year to read the record of what you filed.
steps.headline: Read the record back
steps.instruction: Choose Go to view a period summary, then look up the tax year you filed.

steps.caption: Retrieve the year to date from HMRC.
steps.headline: Retrieve the record

steps.caption: The record shows the reporting basis, its status and the date it was retrieved.
steps.headline: Reporting, status and date
steps.instruction: Read the reporting basis, status and date retrieved at the top of the record.

steps.caption: Below it, the income and expenses from your book, as HMRC holds them.
steps.headline: The totals HMRC holds
steps.instruction: Check the income and expenses in the record against your book.
